verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਗਗਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਅਤਿ ਗਰਜਿ ਗਰਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਿਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau gagan ghaTaa ghama(n)dd bilokeeat garaj garaj bin barakhaa bilaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as black clouds are often seen in the sky who make thundering sound but disperse without releasing a drop of rain.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਹਿਮਾਚਲਿ ਕਠੋਰ ਅਉ ਸੀਤਲ ਅਤਿ ਸਕੀਐ ਨ ਖਾਇ ਖਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau himaachal kaThor aau seetal at sakeeaai na khai khaae tirakhaa na miTaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a snow clad mountain is very hard and cold; it yields no eatable nor can the thirst be quenched by eating the snow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਓਸ ਪਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਸਜਲ ਦੇਹੀ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਨ ਠਉਰ ਠਹਿਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise os parat karat hai sajal dhehee raakheeaai chira(n)kaal na Thaur Thahiraat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as dew wets the body but it cannot be kept at a place for long. It cannot be stored.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧੀ ਚਪਲ ਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise aan dhev sev tirabidhee chapal fal satigur a(n)mirat pravaeh nis praat hai ||446||

en.bdb: So is the fruit of the service of gods who live life in the three traits of maya. Their reward is also influenced by the three traits of mammon. Only the service of the True Guru maintains the flow of the Naam-Bani elixir for ever.  (446)
